title: Annotator in the Loop: A Case Study of In-Depth Rater Engagement to Create a Bridging Benchmark Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a benchmark dataset for social and moral concepts such as 'Moral Outrage' and 'Compassion.'
